creator: Alexander Terp
description:
SurfaceViewTests can drive a composition's commit but not keep one open: with no input method installed, AppKit's default handler commits the character immediately, so 'still composing sends nothing' is only pinned as a pure decision on CompositionArbiter and never as wiring.

That leaves the interesting half of IME untested end to end - candidate selection, multi-keystroke preedit, a commit that bears no resemblance to the keys that produced it. All of it currently rests on one manual check (option+e then e).

Options, roughly in order of cost: drive NSTextInputContext directly with a scripted sequence of setMarkedText/insertText calls, which tests our handling but not AppKit's; install an input source in CI, which is heavy and probably not reproducible; or accept this as a manual check and write it down as one in docs/testing.md rather than leaving it looking covered.

Not urgent - dead keys work and are verified by hand. Worth deciding before anyone claims the IME path is tested.
title: IME coverage needs an input method, or a fake one
